name: Disaar Snail Collagen Sunscreen Cream SPF50 PA+++ 50gm
description:
Disaar Snail Collagen Sunscreen Cream SPF50 PA+++ 50g

Protect your skin from harmful UV rays while enhancing its natural beauty with Disaar Snail Collagen Sunscreen Cream SPF50 PA+++. This high-quality cream not only shields your skin but also refines, brightens, and moisturizes for a smooth, flawless complexion.

Key Features:

High Sun Protection: SPF50 PA+++ for effective defense against UVA and UVB rays

Skin Refinement: Smooths pores, covers blemishes, and enhances skin tone for a natural look

Whitening & Moisturizing: Enriched with nourishing ingredients to hydrate and brighten skin

Long-Lasting: Sweat- and sebum-resistant formula keeps skin protected and makeup-looking fresh

Texture: Lightweight cream, easy to apply

Net Weight: 50g (50ml)

Shelf Life: 3 years

Brand New & High Quality

Achieve sun protection, hydration, and flawless skin in one step with Disaar Snail Collagen Sunscreen Cream SPF50 PA+++.
